data.body:
[P2] Preserve the selected terminal response during cleanup expiry

When a handler returns a small result and `onInvocationEnd` exceeds the deadline, plugins have already received `SUCCEEDED`, but this fallback only preserves checkpointed oversized results, so the wrapper throws and triggers a retry. Both built-in OTel plugins end their terminal Workflow span before flushing, and the runner's `ended` set prevents deadline cleanup from correcting that status. This reports completion for a retried invocation and permits duplicate terminal spans on replay; terminal failure responses have the same problem. Snapshot the fully prepared terminal response after the final queue/termination check and preserve it when only instrumentation cleanup exceeds the deadline. Add held-cleanup regressions for small success and failure responses.
